pre_condition: cli_paths is an iterable of path strings; base_dir is a string path to an existing directory; fallback_base_dir, if provided, is a string path to an existing directory
post_condition: Returns a list of absolute file paths as strings. The result consists of all paths from the FM_AGENT_DOMAIN_KNOWLEDGE environment variable split by the system path separator, merged with all paths from cli_paths (flattened if nested). Each returned path is an absolute path on the filesystem, resolved against base_dir. When a path does not exist under base_dir and fallback_base_dir is provided, it is resolved against fallback_base_dir instead. Only paths that resolve to existing files are included.
